title: Signed integer reconstruction
statement: For every integer $e$, let its sign bit indicate whether it is negative and let its unsigned index be $-e-1$ when it is negative and $e$ otherwise. Recovering an integer by negating the index plus one in the negative case, and using the index otherwise, gives $e$.
